temporal_state_chain.observed: Angela learns from Kevin that he is unhappy in his construction job, feels stuck and unfulfilled, is unsure where to start, and agrees to look into options with her help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela had noticed Kevin seemed unhappy with his job and was concerned, but she had not yet confirmed how strongly he felt or whether he wanted to change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her concern is confirmed and deepened: Kevin is genuinely unhappy and unfulfilled, and he is open to exploring career options with her support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is unhappy and unfulfilled in his construction job, feels overwhelmed about changing, but is willing to investigate options with Angela.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and sympathetic, then supportive and mildly hopeful when Kevin agrees to work on it together.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Kevin explore possible career options and support him in figuring out what might make him happier.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Angela shares job openings and a career counseling service with Kevin. Kevin thanks her and reveals he is interested in something more creative, possibly design or architecture, and says he will check out the resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believes Kevin is considering a career change and is open to support, but his specific direction is still unclear.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. She learns Kevin has a more concrete interest in a creative field, especially design or architecture, and that he is receptive to job and counseling resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is considering a creative career change, especially design or architecture, and is willing to use resources Angela found.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Kevin to check out the job openings and career counseling resources, and continue helping him pursue design or architecture options.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Angela tells Kevin she arranged a meeting with a career coach. Kevin says he appreciates it but is not sure he is ready, then agrees to give it a shot after Angela encourages him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believes Kevin is hesitant about making a career change, and she feels frustrated and worried about his hesitation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her belief in Kevin's hesitation is confirmed, but it updates to include that he is willing to try the career coach despite not feeling fully ready.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is hesitant and unsure about readiness, but he has agreed to meet the career coach and may respond to support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Frustrated and worried at first, then relieved, hopeful, and encouraged when Kevin agrees.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Motivate Kevin through the career coach and support him every step of the way.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Angela checks in with Kevin. Kevin reports that the career coach has been helpful, he has started online design courses, and he feels more confident about the change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believes Kevin is making progress in his career transition and feels proud and relieved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Her belief is confirmed and enriched: Kevin is actively progressing through the coach and design courses, and he is gaining confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is making real progress in his design career transition, benefiting from the career coach and online courses, and becoming more confident.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Kevin by checking in regularly and offering help if he needs it.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Angela organizes a small celebration party for Kevin. Kevin thanks her, says he is grateful and could not have done it without her, and agrees to celebrate.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believes Kevin has successfully transitioned to a new career and feels happy and satisfied.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change. Her belief is confirmed and celebrated: Kevin has successfully transitioned and appreciates her support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin has successfully transitioned to a new career and is grateful for Angela's support; his success is worth celebrating.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Celebrate Kevin's success by enjoying the party with him and continuing to be a supportive friend.
